rules: Frontier is derived from REV697 ancestral nodes plus same-commit exact-core files, historical exact-core references, and prior frozen seeds only.
Producer/reference evidence is evaluated at the exact-core creation commit, excluding post-core descendants.
INDEPENDENT_DECISION_LEDGER_AUTHORITY_CONFIRMED is forbidden unless frontier_exhausted=true and truncation_remaining=false.
Structured CSV/JSON role evidence is required for EXISTING_DERIVED_AUTHORITY_RECOVERABLE.
Code/protocol role evidence may support SPECIFIC_UPSTREAM_DERIVED_EXPORT_REQUIRED but does not count as an already materialized ledger.
No reconstruction, export, replay, model training, raw, 2024 or 2025 access.
